name: normalises email to lowercase + trims whitespace before forwarding
fullName: Newsletter HTTP integration normalises email to lowercase + trims whitespace before forwarding
description:
HTTP integration test for the Newsletter module — exercises the full

client mocked. Mirrors the contract used by the frontend NewsletterForm.
